description: This PHP class, PasswordStrengthValidation, is responsible for evaluating password strength using the Zxcvbn library within the OrangeHRM system. It provides a method to check password strength scores for user credentials.

classes.name: PasswordStrengthValidation
classes.description: A utility class for assessing password strength within the OrangeHRM authentication module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Zxcvbn password strength estimator.

methods.name: checkPasswordStrength
methods.description: Returns an integer score representing the password strength based on the user's credential input.
